name: telegram
description: Send messages via Telegram Bot API. Requires NLS_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and a chat_id.

manual.overview: Use Telegram when sending direct or group messages to users via a bot. Ideal for personal alerts, reminders, and lightweight chat integrations where the user has already started a conversation with the bot.

examples.description: Send a message to a user or group
Poll for incoming messages and updates from users
Send to a group (chat_id is negative for groups)

tips: chat_id is required for send; users get it by messaging @userinfobot or by calling get_updates when they message your bot
Group chat_ids are negative numbers; get them via get_updates when the bot is added to the group
Telegram supports Markdown and HTML in text; use parse_mode if your executor supports it
Start with get_updates to discover chat_ids before sending
edge_cases: Users must initiate a conversation with the bot before you can send to them; otherwise you get chat not found
Bot token in env must be valid; expired or wrong tokens return 401 Unauthorized
Rate limits apply; Telegram may throttle if you send too many messages too quickly
